t: Patch Review Engine - public implementations survey
title: Patch Review Engine - public implementations survey
definition: Examines proposed code changes before integration.
description:
This database surveys Patch Review Engine as it exists in public practice: Examines proposed code changes before integration. The records below name real tools with real track records, explain the techniques they are built on, cite the standards they implement, and provide drills that build working skill. Nothing here is speculative - every implementation is a real project you can download, every technique is established practice.

The value of a survey like this is comparative: seeing seven real implementations side by side reveals what the capability truly requires and where each tool draws its boundaries. The technique records go deeper, explaining the machinery - the algorithms, protocols and disciplines - that make Patch Review Engine work regardless of which tool you pick.

Use this database as a field guide. When a build calls for Patch Review Engine, consult the spotlights to choose an implementation, check the standards to stay interoperable, and run the drills to build fluency. Each record's demo program runs with node - the capability is demonstrated end to end.

t: Patch Review Engine failure-mode drill - practitioner discipline
title: Patch Review Engine failure-mode drill - practitioner discipline
definition: The failure-mode drill discipline for Patch Review Engine: examines proposed code changes before integration..
description:
Good Patch Review Engine practice is not talent - it is failure-mode drill. It turns Patch Review Engine from an event into a repeatable capability.

Concretely: review the result with fresh eyes before calling it done; declare inputs, expected outputs, and acceptance checks before starting; run the smallest meaningful case first and verify it by hand This record exists because the difference between a tool and a capability is discipline. Run the demo, adopt the checklist, and Patch Review Engine becomes something your builds can rely on.

t: Foundation drill - label the seven pillars of the Signature Patch Review Engine

Drill (FOUNDATION): label the seven pillars of the Signature Patch Review Engine on a blank diagram

Success criterion: another builder agrees your labels match the framework
